## Already playing?

You don't need anything from this page. Your launcher checks for updates when it opens and offers **Update now**.

## New to Boost Link? Start here

**You need**

- Your own copy of EXVS2 Infinite Boost **1.04.27**, with its card server (`Server-Infinite`) and Live Monitor (`vsac29_Release_LM.exe`). Boost Link doesn't include any game files.
- Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit).
- The Microsoft Visual C++ 2010 runtime, from [Microsoft's Visual C++ downloads page](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist). The launcher tells you if it's missing.
- A wired connection if you can. The game refuses matches with ping over 300 ms.

**Download**

- **`Boost-Link-__VERSION__.zip`** below. That's the only file you need. The other files are what the launcher downloads when it updates itself.
- Optional: the English menus come in the player pack on the Boost Link Discord, since they're built from game files and can't be posted here.

**Set up**

1. Extract the zip into your game folder, the one with `vsac29_Release.exe`. You should end up with `exvs-launcher\` and `exvs-online\` folders next to the game.
2. Open `exvs-launcher\exvs-launcher.exe`. On first run it picks your network adapter and makes your card IDs.
3. On the **PLAY** tab, click **Check my PC** and fix anything marked FAIL. If it offers **Fix firewall**, click it and accept the Windows prompt.
4. Choose **Online** and press **PLAY**. In game, insert your card, go to online versus and search.

Windows may warn that the exe is from an unknown publisher. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Full guide and troubleshooting: [README](https://github.com/psong-sys/boostlink#getting-started).
